atom_role_rule: In each SMILES, N_azo_left is the azo nitrogen attached to the dimethoxy/propargyloxy ring and N_azo_right is the azo nitrogen attached to the para-substituted phenyl ring. Preserve this mapping after atom indexing.
bde_definition: Homolytic dissociation of the mapped azo N=N bond into the two neutral radical fragments at consistent electronic states; report the convention and fragment states.
scope: No paper or general-web lookup is needed; conformers and computational method are selected and justified by the Agent.
